title: Auto-Save from Payroll — Paystride Save Tier Card
content:
**Paystride Save auto-save: tier figures.** Auto-save moves a share of each payroll load on the linked card into the worker's Paystride Save account. The share is the worker's own choice, within the tier's ceiling.

| Tier | Highest share of a payroll load the worker may auto-save | Payroll load below which no auto-save is taken | Auto-save taken from early wage transfers to the card | Auto-save pauses while the Earned Wage Access plan has an open shortfall |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | 10% | $50.00 | No | Yes |
| Paystride Save Builder | 15% | $50.00 | No | Yes |
| Paystride Save Boost | 20% | $50.00 | No | Yes |
| Paystride Save Growth | 20% | $50.00 | No | Yes |
| Paystride Save Premier | 25% | $50.00 | No | Yes |
| Paystride Save Elite | 30% | $50.00 | No | Yes |

**On the card:**

- A chosen share of zero means auto-save is off. Any share from zero up to the tier's ceiling may be chosen — up to 10 percent on Starter, 15 percent on Builder, 20 percent on Boost and Growth, 25 percent on Premier and 30 percent on Elite.
- The $50.00 figure is the same on every tier: a payroll load below $50.00 yields no auto-save, and a load of exactly $50.00 is not below it.
- On every tier, auto-save is not taken from early wage transfers to the card, and auto-save pauses while the worker's Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan has an open shortfall.
- Paystride Save Boost and Growth share a 20 percent ceiling; the ceiling rises again only at Premier.
